title: Japan–Korea Treaty of 1882
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Japan–Korea Treaty of 1882", at revision 1344861198, opens: "The Japan–Korea Treaty of 1882, also known as the Treaty of Chemulpo or the Chemulpo Convention, was negotiated between Japan and Korea following the Imo Incident in July 1882." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q708068, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1882 treaty between Japan and Korea regarding the Imo Incident". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
